name: Northampton Newcomers A 2024
information:
**Northampton Newcomers 2024 is a series competition.  This competition (the A competition) will take place on Saturday morning.**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersA2024#38747-competitor-information) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.

**This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. Please refer to the [WCA Newcomer Month Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersA2024#38839-wca-newcomer-month-information) tab for more information.**
